newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks finish slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: French stocks finish slightly lower.

text.p: French stocks finished slightly weaker on Tuesday in a consolidation prompted by Wall Street's drop on Monday, but bid speculation livened trading in the insurance sector.

Traders said the bourse was solidly underpinned by the strong performances of the bond markets and the dollar and a partial rebound on Wall Street in early trading, but many said a consolidation of the Paris market was welcome and overdue.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 13.28 points, or 0.51 percent, at 2,582.09, while the CAC-40 February futures contract fell 12 points to 2,591.
Shares in computer design firm Dassault Systemes jumped 13.2 percent to 343 francs after the group reported a 55 percent jump in net income to 342.5 million francs for 1996.
Several analysts said they had or would raise earnings estimates for 1997 and 1998 after the company increased its operating margin targets at an analysts' meeting.
Technip shares fell 3.88 percent to 545 francs after Morgan Stanley cut its recommendation on the energy services firm's stock to neutral after it reached the 550-560 objective.
